entry.title: New: Bill 165 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 24, ARTICLE 10 OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO PARKING

Changes the County Building parking lot located at 25 Aupuni Street in Hilo from a two-hour metered parking zone to a two-hour parking area, effective January 1, 2025.

Latest action: Council: Bill 165, Draft 2 passes second & final reading - 10/2/2024
